scenarios.name: Revenue recovery exercise
scenarios.purpose: Show the arithmetic EBITDA sensitivity if actual revenue were 5% higher than the verified sample baseline.

assumptions.reasoning: Illustrative sensitivity only; it is not a sales forecast.

scenarios.name: COGS reduction exercise
scenarios.purpose: Show the arithmetic EBITDA sensitivity if sample COGS were 20000 lower than the verified actual baseline.

assumptions.reasoning: Illustrative cost sensitivity only; no action or feasibility is implied.

scenarios.name: Balanced operating exercise
scenarios.purpose: Show a combined sensitivity across revenue, payroll, and operating expenses without selecting it as a preferred case.

assumptions.reasoning: Illustrative revenue sensitivity, not a probability-weighted estimate.
Illustrative incremental payroll cost, not an approved hiring plan.
Illustrative operating-cost sensitivity, not a committed saving.
